title: defaultHiddenSeries Bar Reposition Bug

complexity.rationale: Likely a single re-embed/trigger gap between the defaultHiddenSeries initial signal seed and a runtime legend toggle, rather than a new mechanism — but needs confirmation on main before the fix can be scoped further.

summary: With defaultHiddenSeries set, hiding an additional series via the legend does not reposition the remaining stacked bars, even though the initial defaultHiddenSeries state renders correctly.
symptom: With defaultHiddenSeries={['Other']} set, toggling an additional series (e.g. 'Windows') via the legend does not reposition the remaining bars. The initial defaultHiddenSeries state works correctly — the bug only triggers when the user hides a second series on top of an existing default hidden series. Reproduced on both the reactUpgrade branch and main locally; not reproducible on the hosted Storybook, likely because it's out of sync with a recent regression on main rather than a React 19-specific bug.
rootCause: Not yet confirmed. Likely related to the known encode.enter issue: stacked bar positions are computed in encode.enter only and require a full re-embed to reposition. The interaction between the initial defaultHiddenSeries signal seed and a subsequent runtime legend toggle may not be triggering the re-embed needed to recalculate bar positions.

crossCutting.notes: touchesLegendInteraction is true because the bug is only triggered by a legend click toggling a second series on top of an already-hidden defaultHiddenSeries entry. requiresS1S2Parity is true because defaultHiddenSeries is implemented separately in packages/react-spectrum-charts/src/hooks/useLegend.tsx and packages/react-spectrum-charts-s2/src/hooks/useLegend.tsx — investigation should confirm which package(s) actually reproduce the bug before scoping the fix to one.

implementationPlan.change: Investigate first — confirm on main whether the re-embed needed after a legend toggle runs correctly when defaultHiddenSeries was already seeded.
Check for the same gap in the S2 equivalent once the S1/main repro is confirmed.

Likely fix location if the root cause is confirmed as the known encode.enter re-embed issue — stacked bar positions computed only in enter need a full re-embed trigger, not a signal update, to recompute after the second toggle.

openQuestions: Reproduce on main first to confirm this isn't already fixed or React-19-specific.

variant is provisionally 's1' (react-spectrum-charts) since the original report didn't distinguish S1 from S2 — confirm which package(s) actually reproduce the bug and update variant/requiresS1S2Parity accordingly.
